reading.body:
H.R. 1788 has 18 recorded sponsors and cosponsors, all Democrats, and no lobbying filing from 2025 or later names it.

The bill is the Fair Grocery Pricing Act, sponsored by Maxwell Frost with James McGovern, Rashida Tlaib, and 15 other cosponsors. Its latest status date is 2025-03-03. The only issue tagged from the bill's own text is bias and civil rights. That tag is what places a grocery pricing bill in a dataset about AI governance, and it is the sole link the data draws between this bill and AI.

The absence of lobbying filings matters as much as the sponsors. A filing that names a bill shows the bill was an issue in the lobbying, not the position taken on it, so zero filings means no recorded lobbying activity touched this bill in 2025 or later. For AI specifically, that suggests the bill has not yet become a vehicle for the industry's lobbying apparatus, at least not in any filing captured here.

The data does not include the bill's text, its committee referrals, any hearings, or any votes. It does not say what the bias and civil rights tag refers to within the bill, or whether the bill addresses automated pricing, data, or algorithms at all. It also does not cover lobbying before 2025. A reader should treat the AI connection as a single text-derived tag, not an established legislative fact.
